req.title: Update existing player
req.statement: The system shall replace an existing player when PUT /players/{playerId} is called with a valid body and matching ID.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the functionality of updating an existing player via the PUT /players/{playerId} endpoint. It includes tests for positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure comprehensive coverage. The positive test verifies successful updates, the negative test checks for error handling when constraints are violated, and the boundary test ensures the system handles edge cases correctly.

tests.name: test_update_existing_player_success
preconditions: Player with squad number 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send PUT request to /players/squadnumber/1 with valid player data.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

player_data = {
    "firstName": "Updated",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Player",
    "dateOfBirth": "1901-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 1,
    "position": "Goalkeeper",
    "abbrPosition": "GK",
    "team": "Manchester City",
    "league": "Premier League",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/1", json=player_data)
assert response.status_code == 204

tests.name: test_update_existing_player_invalid_data
preconditions: Player with squad number 2 exists in the database.
actions: Send PUT request to /players/squadnumber/2 with invalid player data (missing firstName).
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

invalid_player_data = {
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Player",
    "dateOfBirth": "1902-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 2,
    "position": "Centre-Forward",
    "abbrPosition": "CF",
    "team": "Boca Juniors",
    "league": "La Liga",
    "starting11": False
}

response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/2", json=invalid_player_data)
assert response.status_code == 422

tests.name: test_update_existing_player_boundary_case
preconditions: Player with squad number 3 exists in the database.
actions: Send PUT request to /players/squadnumber/3 with boundary-valid player data (max length strings).
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

boundary_player_data = {
    "firstName": "X" * 50,
    "middleName": "X" * 50,
    "lastName": "X" * 50,
    "dateOfBirth": "X" * 24,
    "squadNumber": 3,
    "position": "Centre-Back",
    "abbrPosition": "CB",
    "team": "X" * 60,
    "league": "X" * 60,
    "starting11": False
}

response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/3", json=boundary_player_data)
assert response.status_code == 204
